title: Visual Notes Sidecar
description: Sidecar JSON written next to a daily note describing the extracted concept-map graph. Consumed by both the Obsidian plugin (renders the visual) and the Claude Code plugin (may produce it).

kind.description: Discriminates sidecar variants. v0.1 renderers handle only 'daily-overview' (and sidecars without a 'kind' field, which default to that). 'session-whiteboard' is a reserved placeholder for future per-conversation graphs (one sidecar per AI session, used for in-flight visual state). 'rollup' is reserved for future weekly/monthly aggregation views. Reserved values are stored without forking the schema; renderers that don't recognize a kind log a warning and skip rendering rather than crashing.

title.description: Visual title (window title equivalent). Auto-derived from filename + date when omitted.

header.description: Visual header shown top-left of the canvas. Usually 'Daily Overview' or 'Session N'.

subtitle.description: One-line summary of the day's themes shown under the header.

_lastProcessedHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the markdown body the sidecar was extracted from. Format: 'sha256:' prefix + 64 lowercase hex chars (matches Node's `crypto.createHash('sha256').digest('hex')` output WITH the 'sha256:' literal prefix prepended). Used to skip redundant API calls when the markdown hasn't changed (handles Obsidian Sync's per-device modify storm).

_sections.description: Optional section-aware extraction metadata maintained by producers. Each entry records the stable markdown section id, direct-section hash, line span, and graph fragment ids used by the plugin to reuse unchanged section nodes/edges/positions while replacing changed or deleted sections deterministically. Consumers that do not implement section-aware merging may ignore this field.

id.description: Stable deterministic section id generated from the heading path. The pre-heading body uses 'document'.

level.description: Markdown heading depth, or 0 for the pre-heading document section.

ordinal.description: Zero-based order of the parsed section in the source markdown.

hash.description: SHA-256 hash of this section's direct markdown slice.

_extractedBy.description: Identifier for the producer that wrote this sidecar in <name>@<semver> format, e.g. 'obsidian-plugin@0.1.0' or 'claude-code-plugin@0.1.0-beta.1'. Useful for debugging which producer wrote a given sidecar. Note: producer IDs are unscoped — even though the npm package name is '@visual-notes/obsidian-plugin', the sidecar producer ID is just 'obsidian-plugin'. The npm scope is irrelevant for debug attribution.

_schemaVersion.description: Schema version string (semver). Optional in v0.x; required in v1.0+.

_pinned.description: When true, suppresses automatic re-extraction by the Obsidian plugin. The Claude Code plugin sets this to claim authoritative ownership of the sidecar (deliberate, curated content); the Obsidian plugin honors it on read. Land this in v0.1, not deferred to a future release.

_usage.description: Plugin-maintained extraction usage metadata. The LLM should omit this field; the Obsidian plugin stamps it from Anthropic API response usage and carries cumulative totals forward across sidecar rewrites.

nodes.description: Cytoscape node specs. Schema caps at 50 (the prompt's design heuristic targets 30); past that, rendering hitches and the visual stops being readable. If a note genuinely has more concepts, the LLM should cluster them into summary nodes (e.g., 'build issues (12)') rather than producing a flat list.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Slug of the concept name.

label.description: Display label. Use \n for line breaks (target ~2-4 words per line).

sectionId.description: Optional producer metadata identifying the markdown section that supplied this node. Used by section-aware producers to keep unchanged sections stable across saves.

classes.description: Space-separated class list: exactly one type class + exactly one status class, in that order. Pattern enforces the rule the extraction prompt's heuristic 4 and 5 describe in prose. Type: system|task|decision. Status: completed|active|context|blocked.

position.description: Pixel coordinates (LLM-assigned in v0.x; may become optional in future when force-directed layout is supported). Bounded to keep rendered nodes inside Cytoscape's reasonable viewport — out-of-band positions previously caused silent off-canvas renders.

edges.description: Cytoscape edge specs. Schema caps at 100; with 50 nodes that's 2 edges per node, well above what the prompt's design heuristics produce in practice.

label.description: Verb phrase describing the relationship. Required because the edge label carries the visual insight.

id.description: Optional stable edge identifier. Producers may stamp this so section metadata can reference edge fragments.

sectionId.description: Optional producer metadata identifying the markdown section where this relationship is grounded. Cross-section edges should use the section where the evidence appears.

classes.description: Optional edge style class. Omitted: default 2px solid. 'strong-edge': 3px darker. 'weak-edge': 1px dashed (use for cross-domain connections).
